models.name: instagram_business__posts
models.description: Each record represents the daily performance of a post or story. Use the most recent version of the user and post to ensure the most up-to-date data.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: The name of this user.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The ID of this user.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp this post or story was created

columns.name: post_id
columns.description: The media ID of this post or story

columns.name: is_comment_enabled
columns.description: Whether comments are enabled for this post or story

columns.name: is_story
columns.description: Whether this is a story

columns.name: media_type
columns.description: Media type. Can be CAROUSEL_ALBUM, IMAGE, or VIDEO.

columns.name: media_url
columns.description: Media URL. Will be omitted from responses if the media contains copyrighted material, or has been flagged for a copyright violation.

columns.name: permanent_url
columns.description: Permanent URL to the media.

columns.name: shortcode
columns.description: Shortcode to the media.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Username of user who created the media.

columns.name: comment_count
columns.description: Total number of comments on the IG Media object.

columns.name: like_count
columns.description: Total number of likes on the IG Media object.

columns.name: video_photo_engagement
columns.description: Total number of likes and IG Comments on the video IG Media object.

columns.name: video_photo_impressions
columns.description: Total number of times the video IG Media object has been seen.

columns.name: video_photo_reach
columns.description: Total number of unique Instagram accounts that have seen the video IG Media object.

columns.name: video_photo_saved
columns.description: Total number of unique Instagram accounts that have saved the video IG Media object.

columns.name: reel_comments
columns.description: Total number of comments on the reel IG Media object.

columns.name: reel_likes
columns.description: Total number of likes on the reel IG Media object.

columns.name: reel_plays
columns.description: Total number of times the reel IG Media object has been played.

columns.name: reel_reach
columns.description: Total number of unique Instagram accounts that have seen the reel IG Media object.

columns.name: reel_shares
columns.description: Total number of times the reel IG Media object has been shared.

columns.name: reel_total_interactions
columns.description: Total number of interactions the reel IG Media object had.
